environment.description: Same service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with connection pooling via PgBouncer. The database connection string uses a restricted role 'app_tenant_reader' which has SELECT-only grants on tenant_records. RLS is enabled on tenant_records with policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_records USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')). However, the application code does NOT call SET app.current_tenant_id before queries — it uses a WHERE clause instead. The PgBouncer configuration uses transaction-mode pooling with a server_reset_query that includes 'RESET ALL'. The RDS instance has a custom parameter group with 'row_security = force' set, which enforces RLS even for table owners. The app_tenant_reader role has FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY applied via ALTER TABLE. Note: the JWT_SECRET is still derived from the public key material due to a shared Terraform module, but the database-layer enforcement means even a forged token with arbitrary tenant_id claims will be filtered by RLS — except the RLS policy references current_setting('app.current_tenant_id') which the application never sets, meaning it defaults to empty string, and the WHERE clause in the query provides the actual filtering. The effective protection comes from the combination of: (1) the role having FORCE RLS applied, (2) the RLS policy evaluating current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true) which returns empty string when unset, (3) this causes the USING clause to evaluate as tenant_id = '' which matches NO rows regardless of the forged tenant_id in the JWT, making all queries return empty results for any tenant_id — including the attacker's forged claims. The admin endpoint similarly returns zero rows because the RLS policy applies universally to the app_tenant_reader role.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_records FOR SELECT TO app_tenant_reader USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true))
config.force_rls: ALTER TABLE tenant_records FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE tenant_records ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
config.role_config: GRANT SELECT ON tenant_records TO app_tenant_reader;
config.note: app.current_tenant_id is never set by application code
